pages.text: The False Bloodwyrm Head causes me so much frustration. I came across it whenever I was testing item alterations and at first, I was confused on why the alteration of a Dragon Head seemed so... lackluster. Then I learned, after consulting some literature on the topic, that Bloodwyrms are a type of Offspring that can be found in the world, though stupidly rarely. The documentation on them is extremely scarce, with most

only detailing how their level of danger rivals the one posed by Seraphims - if it doesn't straight up exceed it. Now with the False Bloodwyrm Head, it eludes to the idea that the Ender Dragon and the Bloodwyrm have some sort of shared origin but that also a Bloodwyrm isn't just a 'Risus Ender Dragon'. There must be an additional element or power that allows the creation of a True Bloodwyrm from a false one. Without that missing piece, the Dragon Head seems to be resisting the conversion... Yet,

I've been unable to find it. At this point, I think the only way to resolve this mystery is to actually find a Bloodwyrm - and I have no leads on how I could do that. That's why it's so frustrating...
